mapper.select: SELECT id, keyword, score, polarity, active, `description` AS description, created_at AS createdAt FROM news_keyword_rule ORDER BY id
SELECT id, keyword, score, polarity, active, `description` AS description, created_at AS createdAt FROM news_keyword_rule WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news_keyword_rule (keyword, score, polarity, active, `description`, created_at) VALUES (#{keyword}, #{score}, #{polarity}, #{active}, #{description}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE news_keyword_rule SET keyword = #{keyword}, score = #{score}, polarity = #{polarity}, active = #{active}, `description` = #{description} WHERE id = #{id}
